locationText: Off Offerton Lane, Stockport. Plenty of space for dogs, kids, and anyone who just fancied a walk and ended up staying for a pizza.
soupText:
The soup changes with what's good — ask us what's on. Our fennel sausage & white bean soup is a regular — rich, slow-cooked, exactly the kind of thing you want after an hour in the cold.
Always served with fresh focaccia on the side.
focacciaText:
Baked fresh on site. Good olive oil, good salt, good bread. Take a piece with your soup, your pizza, or just on its own. It won't last long.
Available to take away too — whole pieces while they last.

pizzas.name: Chorizo, Coriander & Hot Honey
pizzas.description: Spiced chorizo, fresh coriander, a drizzle of hot honey. Sweet heat, properly done.

pizzas.name: Margherita
pizzas.description: San Marzano tomato, fior di latte, fresh basil. The original — no notes.

pizzas.name: Pepperoni
pizzas.description: Classic cupped pepperoni, tomato, mozzarella. Crisp edges, good oil.

pizzas.name: Potato, Crispy Onions & Chilli
pizzas.description: Thin-sliced potato, golden crispy onions, fresh chilli. No tomato, all comfort.

pizzas.name: BBQ Chicken Leg & Red Onion
pizzas.description: Slow-cooked chicken leg, smoky BBQ base, sweet red onion. Proper crowd-pleaser.

pizzas.name: Prosciutto, Rocket & Mozzarella
pizzas.description: Cured prosciutto draped over melted mozzarella, finished with peppery rocket.

pizzas.name: Rosemary & Taleggio
pizzas.description: Fragrant rosemary, creamy Taleggio. Simple, rich, and deeply satisfying.

pizzas.name: Roast Red Pepper, Goats Cheese & Rocket
pizzas.description: Sweet roasted peppers, tangy goats cheese, fresh rocket. Bright and bold.
